source_observed.row_formula: 4 depths * 6 root S3 * 6 symbol S3 * 4 templates * 3 semantic classes = 1728 METHOD_ONLY candidate rows
critical_source_chain: the tag is embedded verbatim into relevant intermediate-node names by _chain
the same tag is embedded verbatim into distractor-node names by _distractors
those node names are serialized by _bindings directly into model-visible prompts

direct_model_visible_leaks: C{c_i} exposes the semantic-class loop index in binding-node identifiers, allowing the model to bypass semantic interpretation of the scenario
S{sp_i} exposes the symbol-permutation loop index, allowing a nuisance decoder to identify the current symbol permutation from identifier text instead of resolving the graph
R{rp_i} exposes the root-permutation loop index
T{t_i} exposes the template loop index
D{depth} exposes referential depth rather than requiring topology inference
finding.why_s3_balance_is_not_enough: Class-to-target marginal balance can remain exactly zero-MI while model-visible identifiers disclose the latent factorial cell. The shortcut is conditional/structural: the learner can use identifier metadata to infer the semantic or routing state and ignore the intended reasoning path.
finding.counterfactual_violation: For otherwise matched rows that differ only in queried semantic class, the generated graph itself changes because C{c_i} is part of every generated node tag. Therefore the semantic-state counterfactual twin is not graph-invariant.
finding.promotion_effect: Block this multihop source from training admission until identifier leakage and counterfactual graph invariance are repaired and re-audited.

formula_reconstruction_non_runtime.method: Independent deterministic reconstruction of the visible scheduling formulas from inspected source; not an execution receipt for the repository source bytes.
formula_reconstruction_non_runtime.interpretation: The marginal class/target codebook schedules look balanced, but first-edge position still carries residual nuisance information; this is secondary to the stronger exact factor-tag leakage above.

swarm_review.adversarial_shortcut_hunter: REJECT current multihop rows: a nuisance-only parser can read factorial metadata from node identifiers.
swarm_review.counterfactual_reviewer: REJECT: graph bytes are not invariant across semantic-state twins because C{c_i} changes the graph namespace.
swarm_review.statistical_reviewer: REQUIRE conditional/nuisance audits in addition to marginal class-target MI; exact marginal balance is insufficient.
swarm_review.abi_provenance_reviewer: No ABI/model/training credit changes; placeholder output slots remain non-admitted.
swarm_review.final_integrator: Repair the existing multihop extension rather than adding another generator lane.

required_repair: Remove semantic class, root-permutation, symbol-permutation, template-index and depth encodings from every model-visible node identifier.
Use neutral episode-local aliases whose lexical form is independent of target/class/permutation; do not merely rename D/R/S/T/C to other readable factor codes.

For fixed depth/root-permutation/symbol-permutation/template/distractor schedule, require the exact same graph bytes across all three semantic-state counterfactual rows; only the scenario/query evidence should change.
Construct relevant chains by neutral root role rather than semantic-class iteration so chain order cannot encode class identity.
Add a hard validator that rejects any model-visible factor tag and verifies graph invariance across semantic-class twins.
Add target/class versus binding-edge-position conditional nuisance checks; position diversity alone is not sufficient.
Keep all rows candidate_train_ready=false until exact ABI atom rendering, tokenizer checks, family splits and all nuisance gates pass.

research_feedback.training_rule: A factorial variable may exist in sidecar metadata but must not be recoverable from model-visible synthetic identifiers unless that variable is intentionally part of the task input.
research_feedback.architecture_implication: Typed causal metadata and model-visible cognition text need a strict projection boundary. Runtime provenance may carry detailed factor IDs; the SFT projection should expose only the minimum task-relevant relational structure.
research_feedback.generalized_falsifier: Train a nuisance-only decoder on model-visible identifiers/order/positions with semantic evidence removed. Any above-null ability to recover semantic class, target symbol, mapping ID or proof topology blocks promotion.

next_exact_action: Patch tools/trigger2_multihop_binding_generator_v1.py in place to use factor-independent neutral aliases and graph-invariant semantic counterfactuals, then add a source regression proving zero model-visible factor tags and zero target/class edge-position nuisance at the declared scope.
